verdict.rationale: First-party self-hosting docs say Supermemory runs on your own hardware as a single self-contained binary using the same engine as the hosted platform. They also describe local graph, local embeddings and local LLM, with no Docker, database or config files required, and pricing lists a self-hosted option. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment, install and operations documentation beyond the overview, clarity on which plan or license self-hosting requires.
